reviews.text: Amanda has worked with us over the past few months helping to train our cockapoo. It has been a very positive and enjoyable experience. Each week she listened to our experiences and gave us bespoke advise helping us to integrate our puppy into our family and home. We have been thrilled by the progress. Maple now sleeps happily through the night in her crate, enjoys loose lead walks and we have gained positive strategies to help deal with resource guarding. It has been a pleasure getting to know Amanda too she is like the dog whisperer! Her advise is clear and workable, her love of dogs shines through and her knowledge unquestionable. I would highly recommend her to other dog owners.

Hamley is our first dog as a family, Amanda has been amazing, having a puppy trainer to talk us through everything was a game changer. We knew nothing,  getting him toilet trained and crate trained in his first couple of weeks was incredible. He is thriving and so are we! Her follow up visits have been really helpful too, helping us as he grows. If you are getting a dog for the first time, get in touch with Amanda as it really does pay dividends. We also have just had our first holiday and he stayed with Amanda, knowing he was in good hands made a huge difference 😊
